title: Cyberussell Academy
tagline: Practical AI skills training platform — courses, real projects, and AI feedback that help Filipinos land online work.
overview: Cyberussell Academy is an AI-skills learning platform with career-path courses — No-Code Automation, AI Virtual Assistant, AI Automation Developer, AI Agent Engineer, and more — each with lifetime access, a certificate, and an optional AI feedback add-on.
problem: Most online courses are generic and disconnected from what actually gets a Filipino hired — no local context, no real projects, and no proof of skill at the end.
solution: Built career-path courses tied to real, sellable outcomes — a client-ready automation, a working AI agent — each with lifetime access, a certificate, and AI-graded feedback on real submitted work.
results: Live and growing course catalog spanning beginner to advanced tracks, with its own dashboard, shop, and certificate system.
